record.issue_text: app/controllers/embed_controller.rb:61 — host_allowed? only verifies the referer matches some embeddable host; the requested embed_url/topic_id is not scoped to that host's category, so any allowed host can embed another host's topics

adjudication.rationale: In `EmbedController#ensure_embeddable` the only gate is `EmbeddableHost.host_allowed?(request.referer)` (app/controllers/embed_controller.rb), which merely checks that the *Referer* host is in the allowed list. Separately, the embedding logic now associates embeds to a specific host/category (`TopicEmbed.import` uses `eh = EmbeddableHost.record_for_host(url)` and posts into `eh.try(:category_id)`). There is no code in the diff that binds the request’s referer host to the `embed_url` (or to the `topic_id`’s originating embed host), so a request coming from any allowed host can supply an `embed_url` (or `topic_id`) for another allowed host and still pass the referer check. This is a real authorization/scoping gap made more significant by the new per-host category behavior.
